'node-' in the sense that it uses a Node-View and that it uses Node.js and '-mation' for 'automation' which is what the project is supposed to help with. <p dir="auto">Fair-code platform to build and deploy AI agents and workflows. Combine a visual canvas with custom code, run it self-hosted or in the <a href="https://app.n8n.cloud/login" rel="nofollow">cloud</a>, and connect to 1500+ integrations. AI automation you can trust with real work, from prototype to production.</p>

<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>AI-Native Automation Platform</strong>: Build and operationalize AI workflows and multi-step agents using your own data, models, and tools</li>
<li><strong>Model Flexibility, No Lock-In</strong>: Connect to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source models and switch providers without changing your architecture</li>
<li><strong>From Prototype to Production</strong>: Design multi-step AI workflows with logic, tool use, human approvals, and full observability</li>
<li><strong>Code When You Need It</strong>: Combine visual building with JavaScript, Python, and npm packages for advanced AI workflows</li>
<li><strong>Enterprise-Ready AI</strong>: Self-host or deploy securely with role-based access, audit trails, and support for sensitive data</li>
<li><strong>Leverage What Already Exists</strong>: 1500+ integrations and 9,000+ workflow <a href="https://n8n.io/workflows" rel="nofollow">templates</a> to connect AI with your existing systems</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What does n8n mean?</h2><a id="user-content-what-does-n8n-mean" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What does n8n mean?" href="#what-does-n8n-mean"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Short answer:</strong> It means "nodemation" and is pronounced as n-eight-n.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Long answer:</strong> "I get that question quite often (more often than I expected) so I decided it is probably best to answer it here. While looking for a good name for the project with a free domain I realized very quickly that all the good ones I could think of were already taken. So, in the end, I chose nodemation. 'node-' in the sense that it uses a Node-View and that it uses Node.js and '-mation' for 'automation' which is what the project is supposed to help with. However, I did not like how long the name was and I could not imagine writing something that long every time in the CLI. That is when I then ended up on 'n8n'." - <strong>Jan Oberhauser, Founder and CEO, n8n.io</strong></p>
